apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **BYD's dialogs after a power-on are answered.** Two switches in Налаштування → Фонова робота (off by default):
  «Дозволяти бездротову налагодку автоматично» presses «Allow» with «Always allow» in the wireless-debugging dialog, so
  ADB comes back without anyone at the screen; «Закривати попередження BYD про неофіційний експорт» closes BYD's export
  warning. One accessibility service the app enables itself; the «Allow USB debugging?» dialog is never touched.

### Fixed
- Wi-Fi no longer drops when the car sleeps away from a charger: with «Тримати звʼязок під час засинання» on, the app
  sets BYD's own keep-Wi-Fi switch (`byd_off_wifi_switch`), so ignition off leaves Wi-Fi on without ADB.
- The SIM slot repair waits until ADB has settled after a power-on (no wireless-debugging dialog pending, adbd not
  restarting) instead of starting at once, and powers slot 0 back on straight away if a step is lost.
- **The SIM slot repair no longer leaves mobile data off.** Its three steps ran in one shell with 5 s pauses, longer
  than the embedded ADB client's 5 s read timeout, so on the car (2026-11-20 23:43) it powered both SIMs down and never
  powered slot 0 back on. The steps now run as separate commands, and a check that finds both slots off with no
  subscription powers slot 0 on.
